prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. \"Capture\" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset)."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"reset":1,"in":32},"outputs":{"out":32},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"out","meaning":"Per-bit sticky flag: set to 1 when in bit transitions 1->0 on a posedge; held at 1 until synchronous reset.","update_time":"posedge clk","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"R1_reset_clear","outputs":["out"],"condition":"reset == 1","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset)","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":1,"in":0},{"reset":0,"in":0},{"reset":0,"in":0}],"expected":[{"out":0},{"out":0},{"out":0}]}},{"id":"R2_capture_falling","outputs":["out"],"condition":"reset == 0 && for each bit i: out[i] | (prev_in[i] & ~in[i])","edge":"posedge","visible":"next_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":0,"in":4294967295},{"reset":0,"in":0},{"reset":0,"in":0}],"expected":[{"out":0},{"out":4294967295},{"out":4294967295}]}},{"id":"R3_hold","outputs":["out"],"condition":"reset == 0 && no bit has a 1->0 transition (out unchanged)","edge":"posedge","visible":"next_cycle","priority":3,"spec_quote":"the output will remain 1 until the register is reset","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":0,"in":1},{"reset":0,"in":3},{"reset":0,"in":1}],"expected":[{"out":0},{"out":0},{"out":0}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"reset","active":"high","values":{"out":0},"first_released_cycle":"first posedge with reset==0"},"mid":"Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.","uncertain":[]}
